verdict.rationale: Cal.com's conferencing docs say every booking gets a location, with Cal Video (native video) as the default. That location can instead point to Zoom, Microsoft Teams or Google Meet once the app is connected to the user or team. This covers every provider named in the story, and native video is also listed as a core platform capability. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that a unique join link is auto-generated per booking, and explicit documentation of the link-creation mechanics for each provider.

support.subject: As a founder, every booking gets a video conference link automatically (Zoom, Google Meet, Teams, or native video)
